# A paid ordinary full-throughput recovery for exact flat mixed encodings

30 October2026. An explicit specialization of random dilation, the flat Petz
map and ordinary known-amplitude amplification. This is a mathematical circuit
construction, not a quantum/source execution, an optimality claim or a new
recovery theorem. Its physical-query bill is quadratic in r, not linear.

## 1. Native input and complete output contract

Fix logical dimension k (k=2 suffices), integer r>=1, and ambient D>=kr.
The native black box is the SAME memoryless CPTP map on every call,

    N(rho)=U(rho tensor I_r/r)U^*,
    U:C^k tensor C^r -> C^D,   U^*U=I.                    (1)

The known inputs are k,r,D and rational target0<epsilon<1. U and its output
subsystem structure are unknown. Arbitrary adaptive/entangled FORWARD calls,
known universal controls, clean known ancillas and protected quantum storage
are allowed. Unknown adjoints, controlled dilations, inverses, input access
to the r-dimensional junk and a quantum switch are NOT given.

The output is one logical system for EVERY already encoded incoming payload,
with arbitrary retained reference. There is no heralded loss/postselection.
For a declared finite number of future payloads, the entire source programme
can be acquired BEFORE they arrive; no original N call is then made online.
Programmes are consumed. This is not an unlimited reusable classical decoder
or an unchanging quantum catalyst.

## 2. Exact flat recovery and its normalization

Write U_j psi=U(psi tensor |j>) and K_j=U_j/sqrt(r). Then

    K_i^*K_j=delta_ij I_k/r,
    N(I_k/k)=Pi/(kr),  Pi=UU^*,
    r N^*(N(rho))=rho.                                 (2)

The CP map rN^* has trace Tr(Pi w) on an arbitrary output w; it is trace
preserving on the occupied support Pi. Add any fixed-output fallback outside
Pi to obtain a mathematical CPTP extension. No unknown Pi gate is inferred.

For ANY r-Kraus Stinespring frame V psi=sum_j |j>K_j psi, define

    T_V w = sqrt(r) sum_j (K_j^* w) tensor |j> .         (3)

T_V^*T_V=Pi, so this is a partial isometry, and tracing its last register
implements the same rN^* on Pi. Changing the Stinespring environment frame
only rotates the discarded register; it does not change the recovery.

The mean inverse S^(-1/2) needed in a generic Petz algorithm is simply
sqrt(kr) times identity ON Pi. It need not be approximated by QSVT o

# What forward-isometry storage does, and does not, supply to mixed recovery

30 October 2026. A mathematical composition and a sharp interface obstruction.
No source, quantum circuit or numerical optimizer is executed here. The input
is the exact flat channel of `FLAT_RDS_RECOVERY.md`; all original calls below
are ordinary forward physical calls. This file does not claim a linear-r
mixed-channel recovery, or a quadratic physical-query lower bound.

## 1. The actual ordinary predecessor

Yoshida--Miyazaki--Murao, 2507.10784v4, Corollary 2 and its PBT construction,
stores an unknown isometry F:C^2 -> C^d using n parallel FORWARD F calls.
For a later qubit input, the retrieval channel is F composed with an ordinary
qubit teleportation channel. It does not apply F^*, F^T, a controlled F, or a
reflection about ran(F). Its output includes the full d-dimensional isometry
output, not a retroactively supplied purification of an earlier output.

For the optimized qubit resource the teleportation entanglement fidelity is

    f_n = cos^2(pi/(n+2)).                                      (1)

This explicit formula and the resource coefficients are from Ishizaka--
Hiroshima 0901.2975, Section IV.2, equations (35),(40),(41). Covariance makes
the teleportation channel depolarizing, so its HALF diamond distance from the
identity is exactly 1-f_n. Isometric composition preserves diamond norm:

    (1/2)||Retr_F - Ad_F||_diamond
       = sin^2(pi/(n+2)) <= pi^2/(n+2)^2.                       (2)

This is a forward service on arbitrary references. A fidelity-only or an
average-input substitute is not being used. All failed PBT outcomes are
included; this is a deterministic complete channel, not heralded retention.

## 2. A paid common-frame adaptive FORWARD service from the original channel

Theorem 3 of Yoshida--Niwa--Utsumi--Takagi--Murao 2512.21260v2 supplies the
parallel superchannel identity

    Xi(N^tensor Q) = E_V [Ad_V^tensor Q],                       (3)

with ONE random Stinespring frame V:C^2 -> C^r tensor C^D. The equality is
of channels on arbitrary joint inputs, not an identity only on maximally
mixed inputs or Choi states. Its Lemma 6 optionally replaces V by the random
conditional isometry

    F_theta = (e^(i theta)|0>V0 + |1>V)/sqrt2,                  (4)

where V0 is public and theta is ONE common phase. Both (3) and (4) have
parallel original-channel slots.

# A further established physical service: approximate complex conjugation

Read directly30October2026: Yoshida--Murao, *Optimal complex conjugation of
unknown isometry channels*, arXiv2607.29054v1, SectionIII-D/Corollary10 and
SectionIII-E/Corollary11, equations133--144.
https://arxiv.org/html/2607.29054v1

The prior supplies a REAL deterministic approximate conjugate-channel service,
not only virtual expectation estimates. For an unknown channel Lambda with
input dimension d_in, output dimension d_out and Kraus rank at most r,
Corollary11 constructs its complex conjugate

    conjugate(Lambda)(X)=conjugate[Lambda(conjugate(X))]

to HALF-diamond error at most epsilon from at most

    n<=d_in(r*d_out-d_in)/epsilon

parallel original calls when the dimension defect is positive. It first
acquires one COMMON random Stinespring frame, applies the known isometry-
conjugation circuit and discards its environment. Corollary10 pays the
covariance-based linear fidelity-to-diamond bound and polynomial known-CG
circuit construction. These are established mechanisms, not new discoveries
or executed circuits in this campaign.

For the present exact flat k->D source, substitution gives

    n<=k(rD-k)/epsilon.

At the smallest ambient D=kr this is k²(r²-1)/epsilon. The known controller
cost is polynomial in the isometry output rD and inverse precision; it is
not declared polynomial in log D. At larger ambient D this particular
service retains its D dependence. The earlier admitted flat inverse remains
a distinct full-throughput alternative with its own stronger output contract
and dimension/precision accounting.

Complex conjugation still maps k->D. Our requested arbitrary-payload decoder
maps D->k. An acquired conjugate query is not itself an adjoint/inverse,
and appending a probabilistic transpose must pay its success, error and
failure-state contract. No restoring draw or coherent inverse block is
provided by Corollary11. No better complete-recovery operation follows
without constructing that missing interface.

The paper proves constant-factor optimality for its GENERAL channel
conjugation service when r is CONSTANT. It does not supply a varying-r
quadratic lower bound for the present reversible-source recovery family.
